Is it the sheer movements of that mouse that make it superior?

The mouse is a far more precise aiming device than a miniature joystick. It handles fast and accurate movement much more smoothly than a controller's analog stick. You'll find most console FPSes have some form of Aim Assistance implemented (and even some PC ports of them still retain this. I had to do a LOT of configuring before Borderlands was remotely playable for me on PC). Additionally, we're talking a keyboard's 104 keys to the 2-10 buttons on a controller.
